confirmedFindings.title: Hardcoded DTMF Payload Type Overrides Negotiated SDP
confirmedFindings.body: Hardcoding the DTMF payload type check to 101 breaks interoperability with carrier trunks that negotiate alternative dynamic telephone-event payload numbers (e.g., 96, 100, or 102), causing IVR touch-tone digit detection to fail.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use the negotiated telephone-event payload type extracted from the active session SDP offer/answer.
